source_text: Exercitio corporum fortitudinem comparat; oculi et aures vegetiores fiunt. Quid prodest ad beatitudinem si corpus roboretur? Emolumentum ad vitam sempiternam quaerendum est.
pass_a_gloss: Bodily exercise furnishes strength; eyes and ears become livelier. What profits toward blessedness if the body is strengthened? Advantage toward everlasting life is to be sought.
pass_b_english: Gymnastics sharpens limbs and senses — but [[bodily training is of little profit >> Bible:1 Timothy 4:8]] for eternal life. Exercise the soul on God’s riddle.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
